scope: Curated primary-source research map for tactile contact state/parameter inference, action-conditioned physical dynamics, sensor observation modeling and planning. Coverage includes foundational sensors, classical vibration modeling, datasets, tactile representations, contact simulation and recent work through 11 October 2026. It is not an exhaustive systematic review or a claim that any single paper supplies a general physics world model.
method: Repository/source/configuration/saved-report audit; seed six original related-work entries and mechanics references; expand through primary author/publisher/proceedings, arXiv, official projects and code/data pages. Targeted section review of closest work; abstract/metadata triage of broader branches. No experimental data or reserved signals accessed, no benchmarks rerun.
year_convention: Earliest independently verified manuscript or publication year in this review; venue/status dates recorded separately. Earlier anonymous/OpenReview or online publication dates may remain unverified.
resource_convention: Null means unverified, not absent; links identify author resources without implying archive, license, calibration or execution validation.

categories.title: Sensor foundations and physical observability
categories.description: Hardware and surveys that determine what contact variables can be measured. Sensor geometry, compliance, bandwidth and calibration constrain every later model.

categories.title: Contact state, force and parameter identification
categories.description: Inference of force, slip, object pose or effective contact properties. These components connect tactile readings to the physical state needed by a solver.

categories.title: Texture datasets and vibration observation models
categories.description: Closest to the current acceleration-spectrum task: measured sensory response, action conditioning, classical texture models and generation. The pushing dataset supplies separate motion/force evidence.

categories.title: Tactile representations and multisensory datasets
categories.description: Transferable encoders, sensory assets and benchmarks. Useful inference priors do not automatically identify a contact law or predict action-conditioned physical evolution.

categories.title: Predictive tactile dynamics and world models
categories.description: Sequential prediction, latent state transitions and world/action models. Inspect future-action inputs, feedback availability and tested rollout/generalization scope for each entry.

categories.title: Active exploration and tactile control
categories.description: Probe selection, stopping rules and task feedback. Informative actions must be evaluated at matched measurement and execution costs.

categories.title: Tactile simulators and sensor calibration
categories.description: Optical rendering, elastomer mechanics and simulated tactile interfaces. Image quality, force calibration, simulation speed and real motion accuracy are separate targets.

categories.title: Physics solvers, contact mechanics and learned simulation
categories.description: Numerical infrastructure and contact/constitutive assumptions for state evolution. These are enabling physics papers rather than tactile sensing results.
